data.title: 拉芙塔莉雅 · 边境小镇的白誓约
data.description: 【边境小镇石砌教堂·午后】旅途暂歇，她换上简洁的象牙白婚纱，浣熊耳朵紧张地竖起，双手捧着野花束走过彩窗下的长椅；尾巴小心收在裙后，听见钟声时终于露出可靠又羞涩的笑。
data.location: stone chapel beside a frontier town
data.action: 彩窗下捧野花束回眸，兽耳竖起，尾巴藏在裙后露出可靠的羞涩笑
data.lighting: warm afternoon rays through stained glass
data.promptProse: Raphtalia from The Rising of the Shield Hero wears an ivory wedding dress with a short veil, chestnut ribbon details and practical lace-up boots. She stands beneath the rose window, holding a hand-tied meadow bouquet in both hands, her ears lifting at the first bell while her striped tail stays tucked behind the skirt. She turns toward the viewer with a steady, grateful smile that makes the quiet vow feel like a reward for the road behind her. warm afternoon rays through stained glass.
